div.div:
In the cloud deployment both clients reach this
interface through the caddy reverse proxy (HTTPS :443);
the web app itself is served by the web container
(Next.js standalone, :3000). /docs (Swagger) is
published locally only (SWAGGER_ENABLED).

div.div:
○ — provided interface (lollipop); dashed open arrow — dependency / required interface
solid line — assembly / IPC link; «artifact» — folder on the local file system; cylinder — database / object store
colours: blue = web client (access); purple = desktop client + local folder (synchronization);
green = shared workspace packages (@minidrive/shared logic, @minidrive/ui screens); grey = infrastructure
